recipient: Soony Distribution Center, Dradenaustraße 12, 21129 Hamburg, DE

verdict.summary_en: Polish WZ delivery note WZ-261110-805 dated 10.11.2026 from Karton Nowak (Poznań) to Soony DC Hamburg against order 4500318768. It lists 74.000 PCS (74000) of CMP-GAM-004 Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 in 74 packages, gross weight 1110 kg. It carries a DC-HAM received stamp dated 13.11.2026 and a handwritten receiver signature 'Yilmaz D.'. There are no corrections, remarks or recorded discrepancies.
observations: Handwritten signature 'Yilmaz D.' on the 'Odebrał' (received by) line.
Blue stamp 'RECEIVED 13.11.2026 DC-HAM', slightly rotated but legible.
Item description is cut off at '(USK/PE' with no closing parenthesis, as printed.
Quantity 74.000 uses the Polish thousands separator and means 74000 pieces; 74 packages and 1110 kg gross weight are stated.
No received-quantity or damage notes are written by the receiver; the Uwagi (remarks) field is blank.
